notes: CurbToken is the curb (CURB) ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers have no fee. Holders can burn their own tokens; burnFrom requires allowance. There is no owner or further minting. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
